title: Navigation
caption: The landing page of the statement suite.
story: The report reads the Warehouse views through the SQL endpoint, so the pipeline's job is to keep the facts behind these pages current.

title: P&L Statement
caption: Profit and loss by account.
story: The statement pages read year-end and monthly facts that the full-load procedures build.

title: Balance Sheet
caption: Assets, liabilities and ratios.
story: Balance sheet figures come from the same year-end facts.

title: Cash Flow Statement
caption: Operating, investing and financing cash flows.
story: Cash flow is built from the monthly and year-end facts the pipeline loads.

title: Aged AR
caption: Outstanding invoices by age band.
story: The invoice facts are the ones the daily incremental pipeline keeps current, so this is the page where a stale load would show first.

title: Revenue Insights
caption: Sales, rolling average and margin.
story: The sales facts are also kept current by the daily pipeline.
